notes: Intro: Product org (CTO + Head of Product) wants an in-product assistant + universal semantic search across docs and ticket history.
Primary constraint: mid-market procurement so predictable unit economics matter; finance wants modeled ARR and 24-month TCO before committing to Dedicated.
Latency target: <200ms p95 on chat queries for core UX flows; throughput target: 40 concurrent interactive users during peak.
Quality bar: retrieval-augmented answers must maintain >85% correctness on internal eval set; small tolerance for model degradation if cost drops >2.5x.
From demo (12/15): liked Redwood Hosted API UX; noted token accounting view in Console is helpful for finance conversations.
Quote (CTO): 'We need predictable bills. If you can show how batching/caching actually reduces costs without breaking UX, we'll be fast.'
Security: require SSO + audit trails; legal asked about KMS integration and retention controls for support transcripts.
Asked for example PO and a committed throughput price band for Dedicated; AE shared draft pricing sheet (drive link).
POC dataset: ~120k docs (help center + product docs) + 6 months of support transcripts (anonymized), supplied via S3 link for POC.
Finance sensitivity: target effective inference unit cost that keeps projected incremental CAC payback under 6 months for chatbot activations.

poc_plan: Week 0: ingest sample corpus, verify embeddings quality on 5k queries.
Week 1: run chat flow tests (95p latency, throughput) on Hosted API; collect token breakdowns.
Week 2: apply optimizations (prefix/KV caching, inference batching) with Redwood Optimize recommendations; compare unit economics.
Acceptance criteria: p95 chat latency <200ms with caching enabled; embeddings recall@10 >= 0.78; cost per 1k queries within target band agreed with finance.
If POC meets thresholds -> pilot on Dedicated with reserved capacity pricing quote for 6 months.
requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS product team evaluating Hosted API first, then Dedicated for production. Use cases: embedded chat assistant + semantic search + reranking for search results. Hard constraints: predictable unit economics, p95 latency <200ms for chat, SSO/KMS/audit logs, EU data residency for customers in scope. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batch sizes, prefix caching, quantization profiles) to show 2-4x cost improvement while keeping quality within acceptable delta.
